name: UWC World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, defended monthly or stripped for inactivity, with challengers drawn from the top three contenders.

name: UWC World Anarky Cup
epitaph: A monthly six-man single-elimination tournament title, with its holder automatically re-entering the next month's field.

name: UWC World Ironman Championship
epitaph: Defended in twenty-minute matches scored by most falls, three times a month and at every pay-per-view.

name: UWC World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's tag team title, left largely inactive by a shortage of teams.
